By trade

Rugged tablets by trade

Different trades break devices in different ways: wet hands, plaster dust, a drop off the scaffold, a day in a cold van. Each page below says what the work does to a device, what matters in the spec, which Tuga we would pick and why, and the accessories worth adding.

Electricians

EICR and certification apps, compliance photos, job sign-off. Sealed against the dust in a consumer unit and the damp in a meter cupboard.

We'd pick the Tuga A8

Construction

Site plans, snag lists and daily reports. A big screen you can read a drawing on, in a body that survives a fall off the scaffold boards.

We'd pick the Tuga A10

Field service

Job sheets, customer signature, photo evidence, parts lookup. One device that does the whole visit without going back to the van.

We'd pick the Tuga A8

Logistics & delivery

Proof of delivery, route tracking and barcode scanning from the cab. A dash mount and a 12V car charger between drops.

We'd pick the Tuga A6

Engineering & utilities

Diagnostic software, GIS and network tools that never made it to mobile. Ethernet on board for plugging straight into plant.

We'd pick the Tuga W10

Agriculture & grounds

Crop records, livestock tracking and field mapping. Sealed against mud, rain and frost, with a big screen for maps.

We'd pick the Tuga A10

Plumbing & heating

Boiler manufacturer apps, digital certificates and photos under the sink. Sealed against the wet, with a flash for the dark corners.

We'd pick the Tuga A8

Surveyors & site managers

A1 drawings, mark-ups and snagging on a 10 inch screen you can read on site. Windows when your survey software demands it.

We'd pick the Tuga A10

Facilities & maintenance

Work orders, asset tags and meter photos in plant rooms and on roofs. Shared devices that live on a charging dock between shifts.

We'd pick the Tuga A10

Warehouse & stock

Goods in, picking and stocktakes with a built-in 2D scan engine. A handheld that fits a holster and survives the loading bay.

We'd pick the Tuga A6

HVAC & refrigeration

Service sheets, commissioning readings and photos of the plant, from a rooftop condenser to a cold room, on a sealed tablet that docks in the van.

We'd pick the Tuga A8

Fire & security

Device schedules, commissioning tests and service records, with a flash camera for ceiling voids and risers. Sealed against the dust above the tile, and a Windows option for panel software.

We'd pick the Tuga A8

Solar & EV installers

Layout drawings readable on a sunny roof, serial numbers scanned in the loft, handover photos in the garage. A bright, sealed tablet for solar PV and EV charger installs.

We'd pick the Tuga A8

Telecoms & fibre

Serial scans, splice records and chamber photos from the roadside, up a pole or in a wet footway box. A pocket handheld sealed to IP67 with a built-in scanner.

We'd pick the Tuga A6

Housing repairs teams

Responsive repairs, voids and compliance photos on a shared device that gets handed between operatives. Removable battery, van dock and a flash for damp evidence in dark rooms.

We'd pick the Tuga A8

Pest control

Bait station scans, evidence photos in lofts and drains, and a signed visit report before you leave. A pocket handheld with a built-in scanner that survives the round.

We'd pick the Tuga A6

Inventory clerks & inspectors

Check-in and check-out inventories, meter readings and a few hundred photos per property. A camera with a flash, storage to match and a battery that lasts the round.

We'd pick the Tuga A8

Drainage engineers

Job sheets, survey photos and reports, from the roadside to the back of the van. Sealed for spray and wet chambers, with a Windows option for survey software.

We'd pick the Tuga A8
